principles.frontend: Frontend defines what can be rendered.
principles.cms: CMS decides what should be rendered.
principles.availability: A component is available to the CMS only after it is published in this registry.

cms_interfaces.page_block: Ordered page.blocks[] content rendered through Gutenberg or an approved shortcode renderer.
cms_interfaces.presentation_meta: Explicit page-level presentation metadata; never inferred from page type.
cms_interfaces.internal: Frontend-owned composition that the CMS cannot insert as a page block.

components.name: Paragraph
components.purpose: Standard editable body copy with meaningful inline links.

example.content: Carry the passport used for the reservation.

components.accessibility: Use visible text and meaningful link labels.
components.responsive: Text follows the article reading measure and wraps without horizontal overflow.

components.name: Heading
components.purpose: Creates an article section in the semantic document outline.
components.accessibility: Keep heading levels sequential and never create a second H1.
components.responsive: Heading scale and anchor offset adapt below tablet width.

components.name: List
components.purpose: Presents related items or a meaningful sequence.
components.accessibility: Use ordered semantics only when sequence carries meaning.
components.responsive: Items wrap within the reading column.

components.name: Responsive Image
components.purpose: Renders WordPress Media with intrinsic dimensions and responsive candidates.
components.accessibility: Alt may be empty only when role is decorative; captions stay visible and semantic.
components.responsive: Uses srcset, sizes, lazy loading, async decoding, and stable intrinsic dimensions.

components.name: Quick Answer
components.purpose: Places a direct answer before supporting detail for fast human and search scanning.

example.title: Quick answer
example.answer: Reserve before arrival and carry the booking passport.

components.accessibility: Keep the answer indexable and use a heading only when it fits the outline.
components.responsive: Uses a single readable column at all widths.

components.name: Key Takeaways
components.purpose: Summarizes the decisions that matter most.
components.accessibility: Render takeaways as a semantic list.
components.responsive: Stacks as a compact single-column list.

components.name: Quick Facts
components.purpose: Shows practical label and value pairs without dashboard styling.
components.accessibility: Keep every label adjacent to its value in logical reading order.
components.responsive: Grid collapses to one column on narrow screens.

components.name: Tip
components.purpose: Highlights friendly supporting advice with low urgency.

example.title: Solo traveler tip
example.content: Save an offline screenshot of the reservation.

components.accessibility: Meaning must remain explicit without color or iconography.
components.responsive: Maintains readable padding and wraps long text.

components.name: Warning
components.purpose: Highlights a travel risk, prerequisite, or failure condition.

example.title: Passport check
example.content: The reservation passport must match the visitor.

components.accessibility: State severity in text and never rely on color alone.
components.responsive: Keeps the accent and copy visible without overflow.

components.name: Steps
components.purpose: Explains an ordered setup, booking, or route process.
components.accessibility: Render as an ordered list with visible numbering.
components.responsive: Number and copy remain aligned on narrow screens.

components.name: Checklist
components.purpose: Provides a scannable preparation list without saved completion state.
components.accessibility: Use list semantics and do not imply persisted completion.
components.responsive: Uses compact touch-safe spacing without controls.

components.name: Comparison Table
components.purpose: Compares options with native table semantics and local mobile scrolling.
components.accessibility: Preserve caption and header cells; scrolling remains keyboard reachable.
components.responsive: Overflow is contained within the table component, not the page.

components.name: FAQ
components.purpose: Presents explicit questions and complete answers through native disclosures.

items.question: Can I buy at the entrance?
items.answer: Advance reservation is the safer default.

components.accessibility: Uses native details and summary with complete visible answer text.
components.responsive: Summary targets retain at least touch-class height.

components.name: Planner CTA
components.purpose: Offers a contextual trip-planning action selected by the CMS.
components.accessibility: Use a descriptive label and disclose external commercial relationships.
components.responsive: CTA content and action stack at phone widths.

components.name: Ticket Reminder
components.purpose: Delegates attraction timing and reminder behavior to SoloToChina Tools.
components.accessibility: The Plugin owns labels, validation, status announcements, and reminder controls.
components.responsive: Delegated form controls stack and retain touch targets on mobile.

components.name: Affiliate CTA
components.purpose: Renders a restrained contextual commercial action with visible disclosure.
components.accessibility: External links open safely and relationship disclosure remains visible.
components.responsive: Copy and action stack without becoming a deal wall.

components.name: Article Hero
components.purpose: Frames CMS-owned article identity and featured media without selecting body components.
components.accessibility: Provides the only H1 and preserves responsive image alt text.
components.responsive: Uses a bounded image-led desktop frame and edge-to-edge mobile composition.

components.name: Share This Page
components.purpose: Shares the canonical page URL without accounts or persisted state.
components.accessibility: Supports native share, dialog labeling, live status, Escape, outside click, and focus return.
components.responsive: Uses a desktop popover and a mobile bottom panel.

components.name: Table of Contents
components.purpose: Builds article navigation from rendered H2 headings only when explicitly enabled.
components.accessibility: Uses a labeled nav and stable public heading anchors.
components.responsive: Renders as a sticky sidebar on desktop and a horizontal navigator on mobile.

components.name: Article Shell
components.purpose: Provides the generic single-article document frame around CMS content.
components.accessibility: Maintains main, article, header, content, and optional aside landmarks.
components.responsive: Controls reading measure and optional navigation columns.

components.name: Guide Breadcrumb
components.purpose: Shows Home, guide hub, and current article hierarchy.
components.accessibility: Uses a labeled nav, list semantics, and aria-current.
components.responsive: Wraps long hierarchy labels without overflow.

components.name: Guide Card
components.purpose: Renders guide summaries in archives, search, and latest-guide lists.
components.accessibility: Uses meaningful titles, image alt text, and a single clear destination.
components.responsive: Grid density and image ratio adapt by viewport.

components.name: Latest Guides List
components.purpose: Queries category-matched posts for selected core landing pages.
components.accessibility: Uses a labeled section and semantic guide cards.
components.responsive: Uses the shared responsive guide-card grid.
